finding.title: Reject non-integer schema-version values
finding.evidence: manifest.get('schema_version') != 1 uses Python numerical equality. Both True and 1.0 compare equal to integer 1 and therefore receive SERIALIZATION_ONLY_PASS, contrary to the frozen bad-schema/types fail-closed requirement.

 manifest=json.dumps({'schema_version':version,'qubits':1,'gates':[]}).encode()
 with mock.patch.object(Path,'read_bytes',return_value=manifest), mock.patch.object(Path,'open',return_value=io.BytesIO(b'OPENQASM 2.0;\ninclude "qelib1.inc";\nqreg q[1];\n')):
